name: delete-event
description: Deletes a Google Calendar event using an eventId supplied by list-events. Deleting an event cannot be undone; attendees are notified by default.

eventId.description: Google Calendar event ID supplied by list-events.

calendarId.description: Calendar ID supplied by list-calendars. Defaults to primary.

sendUpdates.description: Who receives cancellation notifications. Defaults to all attendees.
